OUR STORY

A Legacy of Luxury & Heritage

StayNest brings you closer to one of Mumbai's most iconic luxury destinations, The Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai.

Opened in 1903, The Taj Mahal Palace has become an integral part of Mumbai's history and stands proudly overlooking the Gateway of India and the Arabian Sea.

Its timeless architecture, elegant interiors, exceptional hospitality and rich heritage make it one of the city's most celebrated luxury landmarks.
